population.comparison_source: all v083b QUALIFIED_NEGATIVE panels for these candidates

purpose: For Pair-17 candidates 294130 and 294179, create display-only registered blinks between each science plate and every already-selected same-observatory qualified-negative comparison panel in the frozen v083b dossier. This tests whether apparently absent/weak comparison epochs contain the same source at the banked target position.

registration.center: each panel's banked v083b target_pixel converted through that panel's own WCS
registration.common_grid: local ICRS sky-offset grid around each banked panel target
registration.display_scale: coarser of the science/comparison native WCS scales
